marks.gloss_en: by his tradition -- we do not say it gives birth at incomplete [months]
or say: we do not say it gives birth [at incomplete months]
והתניא: חלב פוטר, דברי רבי יהושע; רבי עקיבא אומר: חלב אינו פוטר -- the baraita has the reversed assignment (marker והתניא; kind tanya_nami_hachi is the nearest member)
rather, reverse: R' Yehoshua holds milk exempts and R' Akiva that it does not
ואמרינן: מאי טעמא דרבי יהושע? ...ולמיעוטא לא חיישינן -- the reason the Gemara gave for R' Yehoshua's ruling in Yevamot
R' Yehoshua's reason (ואמרינן): join the miscarrying minority to the females' half, the males are a minority -- and we are not concerned for a minority
ומי חייש רבי יהושע למיעוט? והתנן: יצאה מליאה -- חוששת; רבי יהושע אומר: אינה חוששת, ואמרינן: ...ולמיעוטא לא חיישינן -- R' Yehoshua is NOT concerned for a minority. Conceded at 20b.7: אלא איפוך
the Yevamot mishna: if her mother-in-law [went overseas] she need not be concerned [that a levir was born]; if she left pregnant, she must be concerned
R' Chanina of Sura: whether milk exempts [the next offspring from the firstborn] is the difference between R' Akiva and R' Yehoshua
the first tanna: a kid that bore three daughters, and each of her daughters bore three -- all of them enter the pen to be tithed
